text_to_speech: I was told by a buddy of mine that I needed to try this bulk sausage so what I did is I just fried it up kind of like it says on the can with some eggs I just used three locally sour farm fresh eggs and with this bulk sausage which has pork stomach tripe and a couple of other key ingredients never had it before so I'm going to give it a run oh yeah if you like liver mush or pig brains and eggs I think that you'll appreciate this kind of like a potted meat almost on steroids it's actually really good this be a great camp food something for you to be able to take out just make sure that you have your can opener or your P38 whatever uh style that you like or just regular can opener this is definitely something that would hit the spot out in the field something I think that anybody can really appreciate and that's coming from somebody like myself who very clearly appreciates their food definitely worth a try I don't think you'll be disappointed
